entries.keywords: focus concentrate distracted study better tips how to study
entries.a: Good study tips: 1) Find a quiet place. 2) Study for 20 minutes, then rest for 5. 3) Put your phone away. 4) Start with the hardest subject while your mind is fresh. 5) Drink water and sleep well.

entries.keywords: remember memory memorise memorize forget learn by heart
entries.a: To remember better: say it out loud, draw a picture, make a song or rhyme, teach it to a friend, and revise again the next day. Practising a little each day beats cramming once.

entries.keywords: exam test nervous scared anxious revision prepare tips
entries.a: For exams: read every question slowly, do the easy ones first, check your working, and keep calm by breathing in for 4 and out for 4. Sleep well the night before. Practise with the quizzes here!

entries.keywords: reading read faster better comprehension understand book
entries.a: To read better: read a little every day, point to the words if you are small, ask who, what, where, when, why after each page, and look up new words.

entries.keywords: homework routine schedule timetable plan time manage
entries.a: Make a simple timetable: same time each day, one subject at a time, small breaks, and finish with 5 minutes to pack your bag for tomorrow.

entries.keywords: mistake wrong fail failed bad score give up discouraged
entries.a: Mistakes are how brains grow! 🌱 Look at what went wrong, fix it, and try again. Every expert was once a beginner.
